title: Conversation & memory
description: Choose default conversation behavior, control long-term memory, and review what the AI currently remembers about you.
loadError: Could not load AI conversation settings.

conversation.title: Conversation
conversation.description: These choices become the defaults for new conversations. An open conversation keeps its own per-thread settings.
conversation.defaultModeDescription: How the character starts and continues a new conversation.
conversation.learnerLevelDescription: Adjusts vocabulary, structures, and the amount of support.
conversation.correctionStyleDescription: Controls how much correction interrupts the conversation flow.
conversation.replyModeDescription: Prefer Chinese or add concise Vietnamese support when needed.
conversation.saveError: Could not save default conversation settings.

memory.title: Memory & relationship
memory.description: Long-term memory lets the character carry continuity across conversations. You can always review, edit, or ask the AI to forget something.
memory.enabledDescription: When off, new conversations do not read or write long-term memory. Chat history remains stored separately.
memory.relationshipDescription: Current level: {relationship}. The AI uses this only to tune familiarity; technical scores stay hidden.
memory.managerDescription: Only active memories owned by your account are shown. Technical fields such as confidence, vectors, and memory keys stay hidden.
memory.emptyDescription: The AI has not stored anything in this filter, or previous items were forgotten or completed.
memory.editDescription: Change what the AI should remember. The previous semantic vector is invalidated and will be rebuilt later.
memory.resolved: Marked this open loop as done.
memory.forgetTitle: Ask AI to forget this information?
memory.forgetDescription: This memory will be removed from long-term memory and will no longer be used in future conversations.
